card.name: Decade and century dates in Asian history
card.fires_on: The digit or word completing a historical date, such as the 0 in 1980s or the th in 8th century, mostly in text about Korea, Tibet and Central Asia.

modes.label: Decade digit
modes.description: The final 0 in a decade like 1920s or 1980s in Korean history text.
modes.example: Kim Jong-Il began taking power during the 198<<0>>s.

modes.label: Century or era wording
modes.description: The ordinal or linking word in a historical period phrase.
modes.example: He notes that this monument is related to 8<<th>> century B.C.

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a historical date, like the decade or century, in history writing about Asia.
